Acute Medical Unit - Continuation Sheet
Ward Round - 04/03/2020, 23:27 (evening medical review, day of admission)

Background: Admitted to hospital at 17:13 on 04/03/2020 with suspected COVID-19
pneumonia and documented hypoxemia. (SpO2 <92% on air at 10:06 on 04/03/2020). Swab
for SARS-CoV-2 PCR taken 21:56 on 04/03/2020, result awaited.

Observations: Temperature 37.8°C, HR 98 bpm, RR 22/min, SpO2 94% on 2L nasal cannula,
BP 120/70 mmHg. NEWS2 4.

Bloods: CRP 88 mg/L, mild lymphopenia, renal function normal, D-dimer mildly raised.

VTE prophylaxis: Pharmacist confirmed the prescription was signed and the first dose was
given on time. Enoxaparin first dose given 21:28 on 04/03/2020, no bleeding risk identified.

Escalation status: For full escalation including critical care referral if required given young age
and reversible illness; discussed and agreed with the patient.

Plan: Continue oxygen therapy, aim SpO2 >94%. Repeat observations and bloods in the
morning. Continue enoxaparin od. Chest X-ray pending review. Encourage
fluids, paracetamol for fever, monitor NEWS2 4-hourly.
